title: 5 Quirky Desk Gifts for Coworkers, Including a UFO That Abducts Paper Clips
byline: RP About the author Rei Padla More by Rei Padla →
excerpt: Find five fun holiday gifts for coworkers, from a miniature office kit to a UFO paper clip holder, with ideas for an office Secret Santa exchange.
content:

Buying holiday gifts for office coworkers can be tricky. You want something thoughtful but not too personal, and another coffee mug might end up forgotten in the break room. A funny desk accessory or a cute gadget that serves a purpose is a much better way to make someone’s workday a little more cheerful.

Miniature office tools, character lights, and geeky gadgets make fun gifts for people who spend hours at their desks. Whether you’re shopping for a Secret Santa exchange or treating your favorite office buddy, these five picks offer a mix of practical features, unusual designs, and prices for different budgets.

1. Kikkerland Anywhere Office Kit

Every office has someone who constantly needs scissors, tape, or a stapler. For that coworker, a miniature stationery kit makes a useful gift with a cute twist. At $12.50, it’s an affordable Secret Santa pick, although someone with a fully stocked stationery drawer can skip it.

Kikkerland packs eight stationery essentials into a reusable tin measuring 7.5 x 10.5 x 3.3 centimeters. Inside are a stapler with extra staples, a tape dispenser with extra tape, a staple remover, a pencil sharpener, scissors, and 20 paper clips. The compact size keeps everything together while taking up very little room.

Price: $12.50
Where to Buy: Kikkerland

Part of the fun is having tiny versions of familiar office tools. The miniature stapler and scissors look adorable, but they’re also useful when paperwork needs organizing or a package needs opening. You can keep the tin in a drawer, carry it between workstations, or slip it into a work bag.

For someone who loves miniature gadgets and practical stationery, this little collection makes an inexpensive gift that earns its place in a desk drawer.

2. Genuine Fred Filing Saucer

Paper clips aren’t exciting, but a miniature UFO abducting tiny cows is another story. Genuine Fred Filing Saucer turns an ordinary stationery holder into a funny desk accessory. Priced at $26.95, it’s an easy gift for coworkers who enjoy science fiction and quirky office supplies. Someone who never handles paper documents can skip this one.

Fred includes 20 cow-shaped paper clips that attach magnetically to a flying saucer. The neon-green acrylic base creates the appearance of a UFO hovering over its collection of unfortunate farm animals. It’s an amusing setup that keeps paper clips together and within reach.

Price: $26.95
Where to Buy: Amazon

Its compact design fits beside a keyboard or monitor, giving your coworker something funny to look at between tasks. The cow-shaped clips can still hold documents together, so the whole thing serves a practical purpose.

There’s also something amusing about seeing a tiny herd of cows suspended beneath a UFO during an otherwise ordinary workday. If you’re buying for the office geek who enjoys unusual desk accessories, this is a fun choice that doesn’t cost much.

3. Smoko Moomin Ambient Light

A desk surrounded by gray partitions and office equipment could use something cute. Smoko Moomin Ambient Light brings a familiar storybook character into the workspace while providing soft illumination. It’s a thoughtful gift for coworkers who love Moomin or character collectibles, but anyone needing a bright task lamp should look elsewhere.

Inspired by Moomintroll, the little light features the character’s familiar white appearance. Smoko lists silicone construction, LED lighting, and USB-C recharging, allowing your coworker to place it on a desk or shelf while it operates on battery power.

Price: $25
Where to Buy: JapanLA

Measuring approximately 3.5 x 3.5 x 6.5 inches, it takes up little room beside a monitor or stationery holder. The soft glow provides ambient lighting, adding a cozy touch to a workstation. It’s also a decorative character piece for someone who enjoys keeping cute collectibles nearby.

Smoko ships this light only within the United States, so international buyers will need another option. For a Moomin fan who enjoys decorating their workspace, the rechargeable light makes a charming desk companion with a useful function.

4. Logitech POP Mouse

For a coworker who spends most of the day working on spreadsheets, emails, and documents, a colorful computer mouse makes a practical gift. Logitech POP Mouse combines playful styling with everyday controls. The Cosmos version costs $29.99, making it a useful upgrade for someone who can choose their own computer accessories. Skip it if their employer requires company-issued peripherals.

Logitech uses SilentTouch technology to make clicking quieter, which helps when several people work close together. Its compact, contoured body is designed for daily use, while the SmartWheel switches between precise scrolling and faster movement through lengthy documents.

Price: $19.99
Where to Buy: Amazon

The customizable top button adds another useful feature. Through Logi Options+ on a compatible computer, your coworker can assign an emoji for messaging or set shortcuts for actions such as muting a microphone or taking a screenshot.

Bluetooth connectivity supports switching between three paired devices. That’s convenient for someone who regularly moves between a work laptop and another computer or tablet.

Colorful styling gives this mouse some personality, while the quieter clicks and customizable controls make it a sensible everyday gift for anyone free to use their preferred computer accessories.

5. Divoom MiniToo Retro Pixel Bluetooth Speaker

Know someone who loves retro computers, pixel art, and unusual desktop gadgets? The Divoom MiniToo is a retro PC–styled speaker complete with a customizable display and built-in speaker. Its regular price of $69.99 (now $47.87 on Amazon) makes it the premium pick in this collection. Coworkers who prefer a minimalist workspace or have a strict gift-exchange budget can skip it.

Divoom includes a 1.77-inch display that shows customizable pixel art, animations, scrolling messages, and retro clock faces. Your coworker can browse designs through the companion app or create their own, changing the display to match their mood or favorite character.

Price: $47.87
Where to Buy: Amazon

It also includes a Pomodoro focus timer, reminders, alarms, and white noise features. The timer helps organize work sessions, while the clock provides an everyday function when the screen isn’t displaying colorful animations.

Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity supports wireless music playback, with USB audio and TF card playback also available. Music is better saved for an appropriate setting in a shared office, but the display and productivity tools remain useful throughout the workday.

For the coworker who loves old-school technology and tiny gadgets, this miniature computer delivers the most features and customization options of the five gifts.

Small Gifts That Make Desk Life More Fun

Office holiday gifts don’t have to be expensive or complicated. Something cute, funny, and useful can make an ordinary workday more enjoyable, and you don’t need to know every detail about someone’s hobbies to find a good present.

Kikkerland’s miniature stationery collection works for someone who loves organizing things, while Fred’s UFO paper clip holder brings humor to a workstation. Smoko adds a cute character light, and Logitech offers a colorful accessory for coworkers who spend hours at their computers.

For the office gadget enthusiast, Divoom’s miniature retro computer is the most entertaining choice. My pick for a typical Secret Santa exchange is the Filing Saucer. It’s affordable, useful, and just silly enough to make a coworker smile.
